profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer | Go, Rust, AWS | Connected Vehicle Platform @ Toyota Connected
profile.summary:
Software engineer building high-reliability infrastructure at scale. Currently on the Ops team at Toyota Connected North America, supporting the connected vehicle platform for millions of Toyota and Lexus vehicles. I specialize in Go, AWS, and Kubernetes, with deep experience in observability, microservices architecture, and cost optimization.

At TCNA, I've delivered on lifecycle cost savings through service consolidation, right-sizing, and caching strategies, and contributed to $300K+ in annualized observability savings. Previously, I built a PoC for Panasonic Avionics (health monitoring for infotainment across 10,000+ aircraft) and fraud prevention infrastructure at Kount/Equifax (real-time decisioning, merchant onboarding).

Core technologies: Go, Rust, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, gRPC, Protobuf, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Redis, Datadog, Grafana.

AWS Certified Developer - Associate | AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on connected vehicle platform serving millions of Toyota & Lexus vehicles.

- Led a team building a vehicle-to-cloud tracing platform for the next-generation voice assistant that records every interaction, letting engineers and PMs triage issues in minutes instead of hours.
- Wrote the design, gathered analytics requirements with partner teams in Japan, built out the next vehicle generation onto it, and decommissioned the legacy system.
- Designed the Rust ingest pipeline for zero data loss: object storage as the source of truth, write-ahead markers with an idempotent recovery job, a search index rebuildable from storage, and automated privacy retention (CCPA). One codebase serves AWS in North America and Azure in Japan.
- Delivered $1.4M in multi-year cost savings by consolidating services and right-sizing workloads. Profiled and fixed per-request TLS handshakes to an external maps API (~40% of the service's CPU), and ramped an in-memory cache that cut GC overhead from 30% to 13% of CPU.
- Cut observability costs by ~$300K annually by standardizing logging and eliminating alert noise. Defined monitors as code in Terraform, scrubbed PII and credentials from logs, and built Istio canary and shadow-traﬃc routing for safe ML model rollouts.
- Built a shared Go service across two vehicle generations: a partner EV API library with standardized retries and
observability, and voice analytics instrumentation processing 8–10M events/day for self-serve product dashboards.
positions.insights: Go (Programming Language), Amazon Dynamodb and +8 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built a POC health metrics service for monitoring infotainment screens and services running on them, collecting and processing system data and transferring it to groundside servers for proactive maintenance monitoring across Panasonic's 10,000+ aircraft install base
• Built safety-critical REST APIs in Go for interfacing with aircraft information systems, ensuring reliability for external stakeholders
• Created real-time Grafana dashboards for system health monitoring, giving operations teams actionable performance insights
• Led a team of 3 engineers to deliver health management system features on deadline

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built a merchant-facing fraud prevention dashboard consolidating order inquiries, alerts, and chargeback management into a single view
• Created a microservice for Verifi and Ethoca integration that streamlined merchant onboarding, boosting signups by 40%
• Upgraded multiple microservices to Protocol Buffers v2 with backward-compatible v1 compatibility layers
• Built and deployed containerized Go services handling real-time fraud decisioning to EKS via GitLab CI
positions.insights: Go (Programming Language), Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +8 skills

projects.title: Threads API Go Client
projects.description: Unofficial, production-ready Go client for the Threads API with complete endpoint coverage, OAuth 2.0 authentication, rate limiting, and comprehensive error handling.

projects.title: FIA F1 Docs Bot
projects.description:
Automated bot to fetch FIA Formula 1 decision documents and post them on Threads. Built with Go, PostgreSQL, Google Gemini, and Docker.

https://www.threads.com/@fiadocs
